newsitem.title: CHINA: China Unicom to open telephone network in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: China Unicom to open telephone network in Shanghai.

text.p: China United Telecommunications Corp (China Unicom) will set up a local telephone network in Shanghai by the end of this year, a company official said on Tuesday.
About 300 km of optical fibre had been put in place and an exchange with a 70,000 line capacity was being installed in the Pudong district of the city for the fixed line network.

The company, created to compete with the main network operator China Telecom, is also preparing to set up local telephone networks in other major cities this year, such as the northern city of Tianjin and southern city of Guangzhou, he said.
Based in Beijing, China Unicom now had over 50 branches around the country, the official said.
The company has said it had 150,000 mobile telephone customers nationwide so far.
